Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Pantheon raised $6 billion for its latest private equity secondaries fund, scoring its largest-ever such haul as more asset managers and investors search for new ways to generate cash.

The capital raise far surpassed the firm’s $3.5 billion target and was almost double the fund’s prior iteration that closed to fundraising in 2023. It will be used to back secondaries deals led by both fund investors and asset managers with a focus on the middle market, Pantheon said in a statement Wednesday.
